messages.subject: Project Harbor — completion arrangements & undertaking
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

For Friday: we'll complete by post under the Law Society Code. On receipt of the completion monies we undertake to discharge the Clydesford Bank charge and to send you the DS1/END once received from the bank. We'll hold the executed Contract, TR1 and rent deposit deed to your order. 3.00pm completion as agreed.

Ruth

messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Rebecca, Isla,

Pleased to confirm Thornbury has today completed the acquisition of Maritime Quarter, Brunswick Wharf. We'll submit the SDLT return and register the transfer at HM Land Registry within the priority period, and send you the completion bible in due course. Congratulations.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
